adjudication.rationale: The diff shows a find-then-create pattern in app-credential.ts lines 57-85: first findFirst is called to check if credential exists, then either update or create is performed. This is not atomic - if two concurrent webhook requests arrive for the same userId/appId, both could pass the findFirst check (returning null), and both would then attempt to create new credentials, resulting in duplicate entries. This is a real race condition bug in the new webhook endpoint code.
